headlines: Old Mother Bell came down off the ridge, ate two bowls, and went back up. No one knows why she came down.
The hearth went out for the first time this month. A small thing. It mattered.
Word that the war in the north has stopped. We will see whether it stays stopped.
footnotes: I sharpened the bread knife. It needed it.
Niamh of the Reeds asked after a man no one in the room had heard of.
The rain came at midnight, as the almanac said it would, which is a first.
